title: Audit telemetry facet explorer - sketch notes and proposals
content:
Purpose:
This note collects sketches, interaction ideas, and backlog items for a compact, high-signal Audit Telemetry Facet Explorer inside the Org/Team Console. The intent is to provide engineers, security admins, and product managers a single surface to triage incidents, answer compliance questions, and create saved investigations without leaving the console.

High-level goals:
- Let users build precise, repeatable queries against audit events quickly (filters + facets + free text).
- Surface the most actionable facets for RBAC, API keys, service accounts, and model routing events.
- Support quick-actions (revoke key, start rollback, open support ticket) inline from results.
- Optimize for low-latency preview and paginated drilldown for large orgs.

Personas / primary use cases:
- Security Engineer: run threat hunting across service account tokens and suspicious region activity; needs export and timeline.
- Support/SE: triage customer reports (who changed model routing, when quota was hit) and open a ticket to infra.
- Platform Admin: audit role changes, API key creation/rotation, and review service account bindings.

Primary flows sketched here:
1) Incident triage: user selects timebox (last 7d -> custom), picks facets Account, Actor Type (service account / user /api), Action Category (key.create, key.rotate, role.bind), and region. Results show collapsed rows with sample event and count.
2) Saved investigation: user composes filters, saves a view (private/org-shared), can pin to dashboard or schedule export.
3) Quick remediation: from any result row user can click an action menu: Revoke API key | Suspend user session | Request rollback | Create ticket. Each action opens a compact modal with pre-filled context.

Wireframe components (low-fidelity):
- Left rail: Timepicker + Saved Views + Facet list (scannable counts). Facets collapse by default if >6.
- Top bar: free-text search (supports exact match and wildcards), query tokens, applied filters chips, Save / Share buttons.
- Main pane: Result table with columns: timestamp | actor (click to open identity drawer) | action | resource | region | severity | notes. Rows collapsed by default showing first 200 chars of metadata.
- Right flyout: Event detail timeline + quick action buttons + links to related events.

Facet types proposed (priority order):
1) Actor Type (user / service-account / api-key / system)
2) Actor Identity (email or id) - searchable with prefix match
3) Action (create-key, rotate-key, bind-role, unbind-role, route-change, model-pinned)
4) Resource (model id, endpoint id, org/team id)
5) API Key Id (hash preview)
6) Service Account Id
7) Region / Zone
8) Outcome (success/failure/timeout)
9) Client IP / ASN (redact by default for privacy)
10) Agent (SDK / Console / CLI / Internal)

Interaction details / constraints:
- Facet counts are approximate for speed; exact counts computed on-demand when user expands facet.
- Tokenized query bar should allow users to drop a facet into the query by clicking the count. Example: clicking "rotate-key: 21" appends rotate-key:true to the tokenized expression.
- For large orgs, default timebox is last 24 hours with a warning if the estimated result set > 100k events. Suggest duck-typed filters (actor type or region) before allowing full scan.
- Maintain audit immutability: any quick action must not delete events; actions will emit new audit events.

Privacy & compliance notes:
- IPs and user identifiers must be masked by default for non-admin viewers; full values shown to users with audit:read/pii role.
- Exported CSVs must be redaction-aware and include a watermark for compliance.

Saved views & sharing model:
- Saved view metadata: name, owner, org-share boolean, default timebox, description, tags.
- ACLs mirror console roles: owner can share to team/org, viewers can clone.
- Scheduled exports: support CSV and NDJSON, retention TTL options (7d, 30d, 90d).

Quick actions detail (security-minded):
- Revoke API key: requires confirmation modal showing last-used timestamp and list of dependent routes. Action generates a revocation event and optional automated rollback of pinned model routing.
- Suspend actor: for user/service-account. Suspension is soft by setting deny-active-sessions flag; generates an incident case id.
- Rollback route: revert to previous pinned model version for affected endpoint; preview diff before commit.

Performance & telemetry suggestions:
- Precompute top-20 facets per org/day and cache in Redis-ish store.
- Use sampled event store for preview + on-demand exact query to storage tier for final export.
- Expose an internal metric for UI latency and query cardinality to auto-suggest narrowing filters.

Backlog & next steps (MVP / Q1):
- MVP scope: timepicker, 6 facets (Actor Type, Action, Resource, Region, Outcome, API Key Id), result table with event flyout, basic Save View. (Owner: Priya)
- Security review: privacy masking + export controls (Owner: Rafael)
- Infra design: approximate counts + sampling strategy (Owner: Ethan)
- UX polish: microcopy for quick actions and confirmation flows (Owner: Leah)

Open questions / tradeoffs to resolve:
- Should quick actions be available from the aggregate row or only from event detail? (Security prefers event-level only).
- How sticky should timeboxes be across saves? If saved view has no timebox, should load with default relative window?
- Export TTL: do we expose org-level policy to disable scheduled exports?

Meeting notes (design sync 2024-11-12):
- Rafael: recommended default masking for IPs and showing only ASN on list.
- Priya: suggested a compact event preview line to reduce vertical noise for triage.
- Ethan: warned about cardinality cost of Actor Identity facet; proposed prefix-index and fuzzy search.

Sketch affordances (visual notes for design):
- Use tight cards with 4-column grid for result table on wide screens; switch to stacked rows on mobile.
- Counts should be lightweight numerics with a small delta indicator (approx vs exact).
- Use orange warning chips when a query would scan >100k rows and require confirmation.

Proposed deliverables for next groom:
- Low-fi clickable prototype (Figma) with left-rail facets and flyout event detail.
- API contract draft for approximate counts endpoint and sampling toggle.
- Security policy doc for PII masking and export controls.

If anyone wants to take a section, ping me and I'll add as owner in the backlog. Leaving sketches attached to the Figma link in CONFLUENCE (see linked artifacts).

Quick reference of related docs to check before implementation:
- product/console-and-rollouts/role-scoped-keys-ux-runbook-and-wireframes (for key lifecycle)
- product/console-and-rollouts/service-account-usage-metering-and-rotation-flow-draft (for rotation actions)

Notes to self:
- Keep the first iteration narrow: prioritize speed and clear remediation paths over exhaustive facet coverage.
- Instrument telemetry early to measure which facets are actually used in triage.
